A '''Sessehshellah village''' was located on<ref name="Rings" /> the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''&mdash;Based on corresponding data for [[Shaymore system/Legends|Shaymore system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Shaymore]]. During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the Empire's forces razed the village in retaliation for [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]&ndash;backed activity carried out against an Imperial patrol by the native [[Sessehshellah]].<ref name="Rings" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Sessehshellah village was first mentioned in "[[Rings of Bright Water]]", an adventure written by [[Ken Rolston]] and collected in the [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|first edition]] of ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' in [[October]] [[1987]].<ref name="Rings" />
